cards.title: Model Development and Covariate Identification
cards.claim: Structural models should be informed by data exploration and scientific rationale. Covariate-parameter relationships should be based on biology, physiology, or allometry. Correct identification of covariate relationships is essential for applying models to untested scenarios. Outliers should be handled with prespecified criteria, and missing data/BLQ must be addressed with appropriate methods.
conditions: Structural model must account for covariance between parameters (e.g., CL and V) if relevant.
Covariate analysis methods (stepwise, full model, Lasso) must be justified.
Outlier removal is discouraged unless due to protocol violation/human error.
limitations: Inappropriate structural models can lead to incorrect covariate identification.
Parameter identifiability issues may arise (indicated by high condition number >1000).
cards.downstream_use: Building mechanistic or empirical PK models; identifying covariates for dose adjustment.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
